notes.title: SCAR Runner giveaway campaign extended
notes.content:
We're extending the ROG SCAR Runner giveaway until July 25. Try the free ROG Citadel XV game on Steam before that date for a chance to win the ROG Strix Scar SE with the latest Intel i9-12950HX CPU and GeForce RTX 3080Ti, and more prizes.

How to participate the giveaway:
1. Visit our official campaign site/Gleam page

2. Login or link your Gleam account with your Steam or other social accounts

3. Download ROG Citadel XV

4. Play ROG Citadel XV for 0.2 hours-mandatory for entry (You need to click Adventure and scroll to chapter 3 to play the SCAR Runner)

5. Complete other tasks on Gleam to gain extra entries and increase your chances of winning

6. You’re done! We will announce the winners soon

Full contest rules can be found here.

notes.title: Official update for SCAR Runner campaign
notes.content:
Hi Gamers,

It has been brough to our attention that a few users have been facing some issues in participating in the SCAR Runner giveaway launched on May 17, 2022. We have since then worked to resolve these issues; however in the event you may encounter an issue, we have pointed out the issues below and how to handle them: 

1.	Authentication
All of the Steam actions on Gleam will require the user to authenticate their accounts via the Gleam.io Steam app.

2.	Limited Profiles
If you are seeing this error you will need to ensure that your Steam profile is not Limited and that your profile does not look like it is created just to redeem free keys or enter competitions.

3.	Private Profiles
Steam limits access to the Web API for users with limited profiles. Users with limited profiles will not be able to complete certain actions.

4.	Steam API
We had originally asked users to play ROG SCAR Runner at least 0.2 hours to qualify for the giveaway, however because Gleam seems to have issues accurately counting the playtime for this DLC, we will be switching this requirement to “play ROG Citadel XV (main game) at least 0.2 hours to qualify for the giveaway.” 
Those who have already played SCAR Runner and finished this task on Gleam will still have their entries counted in. Gleam giveaway

5.	Gleam support
If you are still facing issues in joining the campaign, please feel free to contact Gleam support at: https://gleam.io/contact

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this has caused and hope you all will have an extraordinary journey playing ROG Citadel XV and SCAR Runner. We wish you the best of luck in our giveaway to win our new powerful ROG Strix SCAR SE gaming laptops!

ROG team

notes.title: ROG SCAR Runner giveaway campaign
notes.content:
To celebrate the launch of SCAR Runner and the new laptop, ROG is pleased to announce a global giveaway campaign running from May 17th, 2022, through July 25th, 2022. Gamers stand the chance of winning a whole host of ROG products from gaming monitors, headsets, mice and more, including the grand prize featuring a ROG Strix SCAR 17 SE gaming laptop and a complete ROG peripheral bundle. Gamers can enter the contest by signing up to Gleam and playing the new SCAR Runner game and ROG Citadel XV. 

1. Visit our official campaign site/Gleam page

2. Login or link your Gleam account with your Steam or other social accounts

3. Download ROG Citadel XV

4. Play ROG Citadel XV for 0.2 hours-mandatory for entry (You need to click Adventure and scroll to chapter 3 to play the SCAR Runner)

5. Complete other tasks on Gleam to gain extra entries and increase your chances of winning

6. You’re done! We will announce the winners soon

Full contest rules can be found here.

notes.title: ROG CITADEL XV 1.5 update
notes.content:
The citadel is in trouble—and needs your help! Fight your way through a citadel under attack with the help of OMNI in the next chapter of the ROG CITADEL XV saga, now available on Steam.
New additions include:
Chapter Two – Crash Course
• A new chapter of the storyline, with new characters, enemies, and weapons
• A map 18 times larger than the previous version, with new missions to complete
Gallery
• An updated terminal machine with newly-announced ROG laptops, PC components, and peripherals for 2022
New mini-games
• New mini-games available in your hideout to pass the time between chapters
• New weapons require practice. Try out the renewed training modes

notes.title: ROG CITADEL XV 1.1 update
notes.content: Explore a rebel armory filled with the latest ROG gear, uncover secret surprises, and put your skills to the test in a unique virtual experience.
